n7604dbc1fa.headline: Energean profits rise despite revenue decline
n7604dbc1fa.summary: Energean reported a rise in half-year profits despite a fall in revenue, as strong summer demand for its Israeli gas assets offset a temporary production halt and weaker oil prices.
n7604dbc1fa.why: Energean is an oil and gas producer whose main operations are Israeli offshore gas fields, so its results are sensitive to gas demand and oil prices.

n9de77d91ac.headline: Share Market Highlights 11 September 2025: Sensex rises 124 points, Nifty reclaims 25,000 despite rupee hitting record low
n9de77d91ac.summary: The BSE Sensex rose 123.58 points to 81,548.73 and the NSE Nifty gained 32.40 points to 25,005.50. The rupee hit a record low during the session, according to BusinessLine.
n9de77d91ac.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the benchmark equity indices of India's stock market. The rupee's exchange rate affects foreign investor returns and import costs.

impacts.name: BSE Sensex
impacts.why: The benchmark index ended higher on the day, gaining 0.15 per cent.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

na45666c18a.headline: World Bank ups size of sustainable development bonds
na45666c18a.summary: The World Bank has increased the size of its August 2028 and February 2035 sustainable development bonds, according to Trend.Az, citing the issuer's rating of Aaa/AAA.
na45666c18a.why: The World Bank is a supranational AAA-rated issuer, and its bond sizes are watched by fixed-income investors as a benchmark for sustainable debt.

ncdcd62fb94.headline: Tariffs: Home textile manufacturers bracing for 5-10% fall in revenue, says Crisil
ncdcd62fb94.summary: Indian home textile makers expect revenue to fall 5-10% and profitability to shrink after 50% US tariffs took effect on August 27, 2025. Diversification into the EU and UK is expected.
ncdcd62fb94.why: The US is a major export market for Indian textiles, so tariffs on these goods reduce sector revenue and push producers toward other markets.

ne6208789b7.headline: Uganda sees average 8% annual growth over five years boosted by oil
ne6208789b7.summary: Uganda's economy is expected to grow by an average 8% a year over the next five years, driven by petroleum investment and transport, the finance ministry said. Crude output is expected from around mid-2026.
ne6208789b7.why: Uganda's growth outlook depends on its emerging oil sector, which is expected to attract large foreign investment and reshape public finances.

n2ea255c284.headline: Mexican peso and Brazilian real overvalued, says Morgan Stanley
n2ea255c284.summary: Morgan Stanley has declared the Mexican peso and Brazilian real overpriced. The bank is restructuring its Latin American debt positions away from strategies that depend on current currency levels.
n2ea255c284.why: Morgan Stanley is a major global investment bank, and its currency views influence positioning in emerging-market debt and FX.

impacts.name: Mexican peso
impacts.why: The bank's view that the peso is overpriced concerns the peso's valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

impacts.name: Brazilian real
impacts.why: The same overvaluation view covers the Brazilian real.

n9cfd6faf3d.headline: Thursday newspaper round-up: Merck, North Sea, life sciences
n9cfd6faf3d.summary: US drugmaker Merck has scrapped a £1bn London research centre and is laying off 125 scientists in the capital this year. The move is a blow to the UK's life sciences sector.
n9cfd6faf3d.why: Merck & Co. is a large US pharmaceutical company, and its research investment decisions signal confidence in UK life sciences.

nfadacb89f6.headline: Consumer prices rose in August. See which of your grocery items went up
nfadacb89f6.summary: US consumer prices rose 0.4% last month after increasing 0.2% in July, the largest monthly increase in seven months. The report highlights which grocery items went up.
nfadacb89f6.why: Consumer price inflation data shapes Federal Reserve rate expectations, which influence Treasury yields and equity valuations.
nfadacb89f6.why_moved: The August consumer price rise of 0.4% was the largest in seven months, after 0.2% in July. Faster inflation can raise expectations of tighter monetary policy, which tends to lift bond yields.

n3f3141e61b.headline: Rosatom continues implementing Paks-2 NPP project despite EU Court ruling
n3f3141e61b.summary: Rosatom says it will keep implementing the Paks-2 nuclear plant project in Hungary, prioritising safety standards and contractual obligations. The statement follows an EU Court ruling on the project.
n3f3141e61b.why: Rosatom is Russia's state nuclear corporation, and Paks-2 is a large Russian-built reactor project in Hungary, so EU legal rulings affect its financing and timeline.

n6d0f33cc01.headline: Tata Motors and Iveco in CV tie-up talks
n6d0f33cc01.summary: Tata Motors and Iveco are exploring a commercial vehicle partnership, covering strategic rationale, product scope and global market implications. No terms have been reported.
n6d0f33cc01.why: Tata Motors is an Indian automaker with a large commercial vehicle business, and Iveco is a European truck and bus maker, so a tie-up would reshape both firms' truck portfolios.

n2007a0eb3c.headline: Trainline shares surge on upbeat FY outlook as sales rise 8%
n2007a0eb3c.summary: Trainline shares surged after it said full-year earnings should be at the upper end of guidance following an 8% rise in interim sales. The company will also start a £150m share buyback.
n2007a0eb3c.why: Trainline is a London-listed online rail ticketing platform, so its sales trends and capital returns are closely watched by UK equity investors.
n2007a0eb3c.why_moved: Shares surged after the company guided full-year earnings to the upper end of its range and announced a £150m share buyback.

ndf76a22dc8.headline: “Erosion, not crash”: CA points out harsh reality of Bengaluru housing market amid IT slowdown - BusinessToday
ndf76a22dc8.summary: Prices in IT hubs such as Whitefield, Sarjapur and Electronic City have jumped beyond the reach of mid-level professionals. The commentary links this to an IT slowdown.
ndf76a22dc8.why: Bengaluru is India's main technology hub, and its housing market reflects employment and wage trends in the IT services sector.

n8361ef7fe9.headline: Oyedele debunks claims of secret new tax law
n8361ef7fe9.summary: Taiwo Oyedele, chairman of Nigeria's presidential committee on fiscal policy and tax reform, dismissed claims that the government introduced a new tax law in secret.
n8361ef7fe9.why: Nigeria's tax regime shapes corporate and household obligations and the government's revenue base, which matters for investors in Nigerian assets.

n89804a9507.headline: London open: Stocks gain ahead of US inflation reading
n89804a9507.summary: London stocks rose in early trade, following Wall Street where the S&P 500 and Nasdaq hit more record highs. Investors were awaiting the latest US consumer price inflation reading.
n89804a9507.why: The FTSE 100 is the UK's benchmark index of large companies, and US inflation data influences global interest-rate expectations.

n3320e15c59.headline: Indonesia's plan for 80,000 new co-ops is a daunting task
n3320e15c59.summary: Indonesia's plan for 80,000 new village co-operatives aims to cut poverty through simpler market access and supply chains. Finance, governance and training are described as vital to success.
n3320e15c59.why: Village cooperatives are community-based enterprises, and their scale-up affects rural incomes, supply chains and credit demand in Indonesia.

n2250d40d88.headline: Rupee plunges 36 paise to close at all-time low of 88.47 against US dollar
n2250d40d88.summary: The rupee closed at an all-time low of 88.47 against the dollar, pressured by tariff concerns, foreign institutional investor outflows and global factors.
n2250d40d88.why: The rupee is India's currency, and its level affects import costs, inflation and returns for foreign investors in Indian assets.
n2250d40d88.why_moved: Tariff concerns and foreign institutional investor outflows weighed on the rupee, pushing it to a record low against the dollar.

nbb26cb0e58.headline: London midday: FTSE extends gains as investors eye US inflation
nbb26cb0e58.summary: London stocks extended their gains by midday on Thursday as investors looked ahead to the latest US consumer price inflation reading.
nbb26cb0e58.why: The FTSE 100 is the benchmark index of the largest companies listed in London, and its moves reflect UK equity sentiment and global risk appetite.
nbb26cb0e58.why_moved: Investors were positioning ahead of the latest US consumer price inflation reading, which bears on expectations for interest rates.

n3076513121.headline: Services trade fair shows China’s continued commitment to opening up, expert says
n3076513121.summary: An expert said the 2025 China International Fair for Trade in Services shows China's continued commitment to opening up its market.
n3076513121.why: China's market-opening measures affect foreign companies' access to its large services sector and the outlook for trade flows.

n4f84475e15.headline: Centurion REIT eyes $1.18 billion valuation, raising $771.1 million in Singapore IPO
n4f84475e15.summary: Centurion Accommodation REIT is targeting a valuation of up to S$1.51 billion and raising $771.1 million in its Singapore IPO.
n4f84475e15.why: A real estate investment trust (REIT) owns income-producing property and is usually valued on its yield and net asset value.

nf8e1f40cdf.headline: 'We're Not Trying To Be Michael Saylor,' Figma CEO Dylan Field Says The Firm Is Not A Bitcoin Holding Company Despite BTC ETF Holdings
nf8e1f40cdf.summary: Figma CEO Dylan Field said the company is not trying to become a proxy for bitcoin despite increasing exposure to the digital asset.
nf8e1f40cdf.why: Figma is a US software company whose equity can be affected by its treasury and investment decisions.

n9d07db1f90.headline: La BCE devrait laisser ses taux inchangés, sans fermer la porte à une baisse supplémentaire
n9d07db1f90.summary: The European Central Bank is expected to leave its interest rates unchanged on Thursday, as inflation is in line with its target. It is not ruling out further easing.
n9d07db1f90.why: The ECB sets interest rates for the euro area, and its decisions influence borrowing costs, bond yields and the euro's value.

nab1552aa7c.headline: Mexican tariffs give Japan’s carmakers an edge over Korean rivals
nab1552aa7c.summary: Mexico's higher tariffs are expected to apply to more than 1,400 product categories from countries without a trade agreement with Mexico. The measure is seen giving Japan's carmakers an advantage over Korean rivals.
nab1552aa7c.why: Mexico is a major auto-manufacturing and export hub, so tariff changes directly affect carmakers' costs and competitiveness in North American markets.

nc0e25a35a1.headline: SMG to be valued at up to $5.6 billion in next week's IPO
nc0e25a35a1.summary: Swiss Marketplace Group is set to be valued at up to $5.6 billion in its upcoming IPO on the Swiss stock exchange, expected on or around September 19. Major stakeholder TX Group announced the plan.
nc0e25a35a1.why: An IPO is the first sale of shares to the public, and valuation levels indicate investor appetite for new listings. Swiss Marketplace Group operates online marketplaces in Switzerland.

n682fb7ebdc.headline: DAX FLASH:  Further small losses expected
n682fb7ebdc.summary: Broker IG estimates the German DAX index will continue the previous day's losses when trading opens on Xetra on Thursday. The expected decline is described as small.
n682fb7ebdc.why: The DAX is Germany's benchmark blue-chip index of 40 large companies traded on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange. It is a key gauge of European equity sentiment.

impacts.name: DAX
impacts.why: The index is expected to open lower, continuing the previous day's losses.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n8ca40fd2dd.headline: Sensex opens marginally up, Nifty near 25,000 amid mixed global cues
n8ca40fd2dd.summary: Indian benchmark indices opened marginally higher on Thursday, with the Nifty near 25,000. Developments in bilateral trade discussions between India and the United States were cited among global cues.
n8ca40fd2dd.why: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty are India's main benchmark equity indices, tracking the country's largest listed companies.

n0bb21e03f4.headline: Thai consumer confidence at lowest in over two years in August
n0bb21e03f4.summary: Thai consumer confidence fell for a seventh straight month in August to its lowest level in 32 months. Concerns cited include a slow economic recovery, political instability and US trade issues.
n0bb21e03f4.why: Consumer confidence is a leading indicator of household spending, which is a large share of Thailand's economy and tourism-linked activity.

nbd6da30ea5.headline: Google Launches Affordable Gemini AI Plus Plan Under $5 A Month
nbd6da30ea5.summary: Google has introduced a new subscription tier for its Gemini AI service. The plan aims to make advanced AI tools more accessible in emerging markets.
nbd6da30ea5.why: Alphabet's Google is a leading AI developer, and subscription pricing for its AI products shapes competition with other AI model providers and monetisation of generative AI.

nbbabe7c091.headline: Sask. copper mine one of five major projects announced by Carney
nbbabe7c091.summary: A Saskatchewan copper mine is one of five major projects announced by Prime Minister Mark Carney, moving forward under Bill C-5. The mine is expected to begin commercial production in mid-2026.
nbbabe7c091.why: Copper is a key industrial metal used in electrification and construction, and Canadian mine output affects global copper supply and Canadian resource investment.

n70bdf557e8.headline: Adani Ports bars vessels facing sanctions from US, UK and EU | Mint
n70bdf557e8.summary: Adani Ports will bar vessels facing sanctions from the US, UK and EU to protect the port's legal and commercial interests, as several ships carrying Russian oil have already been sanctioned.
n70bdf557e8.why: Adani Ports is one of India's largest port operators, and sanctions compliance affects its shipping customers and legal exposure.

n2cf39de556.headline: Canada to Champion Mining, Energy and Port Projects in Economic Revamp -- Update
n2cf39de556.summary: Canada will throw its weight behind five projects covering mining, energy and infrastructure to ensure their completion as part of an economic revamp. The announcement was reported by MarketScreener.
n2cf39de556.why: Government backing for resource and infrastructure projects can speed permitting and financing, affecting miners, energy producers and port operators.
